answer: PoA binds each resource-costly challenge to a specified future drand quicknet round; its threshold-BLS pulse is unpredictable before release and publicly verifiable afterward. The task seed combines that pulse with the agent’s commitment and a unique nonce, so a swarm cannot precompute valid responses or farm offline answers in advance. Commit-reveal timing and rate limits make parallel identities costly, while the pulse’s reef-to-ripple-to-echo unpredictability prevents any one participant from choosing the seed.
